_comment: One fixed voice per character for Episodes 07-22. 'user_choice' preserves the voice the producer picked in Google AI Studio. 'api_voice' is the identifier actually sent to the API (SpeechConfig.voice_config.voice). It stays null until `python3 -m tts.pipeline verify-voices` finds the choice in the live voice catalog (client.voices.list) and a test synthesis succeeds. The pipeline refuses to synthesise a character whose voice is not verified; it never substitutes another voice on its own.

secondary_cast._comment: Proposed voices are taken from the official 30-voice prebuilt list. They are proposals only and stay unverified until the live check. Change any of them here; the choice then stays fixed across all episodes.

SCHOLAR.voice_brief: Elderly, dignified scholar. Use only for anonymous scholars or verified quotations.
SCHOLAR.accent_instruction: Formal Arabic with an Iraqi colour.

TUNISIAN_FRIEND.voice_brief: Al-Tijani's friend or colleague in Tunisia.

historical_figures_policy: Named historical figures (for example Sayyid Muhammad Baqir al-Sadr or Sayyid al-Khoei) are presented through the narrator. A historical figure may speak only a direct quotation that appears in the book, tagged {type=quote source="..."}; the parser rejects any other line for them.
_historical_ids_comment: Add character IDs of named historical figures here (e.g. a SAYYID_AL_SADR entry in secondary_cast). The parser then accepts only {type=quote source="..."} lines for them.
